plays.desc_en: After tearing down the mid inhibitor, Delight knocks up Dhokla to launch HLE's final assault on the Nexus; Dhokla and Inspired fall in quick succession as HLE dives the fountain to score an Ace, smashing the Nexus with a deathless Zeus to advance to the Grand Finals.
plays.quote: destroyed. 21 minutes into the game. HLE ... now putting pressure on the mid lane. ... Second inhibitor about to fall. Delight
